To add pagination to the `ArticlesController#index` action using the Kaminari gem, you first need to ensure that the gem is included in your `Gemfile` and then run `bundle install`. Here's how you can modify the `ArticlesController`: ```ruby # Gemfile gem 'kaminari' # app/controllers/articles_controller.rb class ArticlesController < ApplicationController def index @articles = Article.order(created_at: :desc).page(params[:page]).per(10) end end ``` In the view file (e.g., `app/views/articles/index.html.erb`), you'll need to include the pagination links: ```erb <% @articles.each do |article| %>

<%= article.title %>

<% end %> <%= paginate @articles %> ``` This code sets up pagination for the articles, displaying 10 articles per page. The `page(params[:page])` method fetches the current page of records based on the `:page` parameter passed through the URL. The `per(10)` method specifies that each page should contain 10 records.
